newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae revises upwards '96 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Sonae revises upwards '96 profit forecast.

text.p: Portuguese industrial group Sonae Investimentos revised upwards its forecast for 1996 net consolidated profit to 19 billion escudos from a forecast of 13.9 billion escudos made at the presentation of its first half 1996 results, the Lisbon bourse official bulletin said.
Sonae's forecasts for turnover and current profits for 1996 were unchanged at 460 billion escudos and 17.5 billion respectively, the bulletin said.
On December 31, Sonae revised upwards its forecast for 1996 profits to 12 billion escudos from an earlier forecast of 5.6 billion announced in September 1996.
Sonae is expected to present its 1996 results on March 17.
